- `bat cache --clear` now clears the `--target` directory when provided, falling back to the default cache directory otherwise.
- Removed `requires("build")` from `--source` and `--target` so they work with `--clear`.

`cargo test --test integration_tests cache` passes (6/6). The full suite hits an unrelated pre-existing SIGABRT in `no_args_doesnt_break` (`IO Safety violation`).
